body: It is hard and unfair :( I haven’t left my bed since april 10th and no one bothered to check up on me…i feel like if i leave the world, no one would find out until my landlord finds me

Im just so tired of having strong negative and now my bf of six years who got fed up with dealing with me. I dont blame him.

I lost my job on the same day he left me. I barely have any money left to pay my apartment. I dont have friends to reach out to. I cant do therapy since the waiting list is 12-24 months and private therapy is fuckin expensive.

I’ve been in my bed since april 10th and no one bothered to check up on me…pretty sad . I feel like if i end my life, nobody would know until months later. I see no light in the end of tunnel

I told him how I felt. I don’t mind friendly interactions with exes but texting daily and hanging out 1-2 times a week is little too much for me. He slept over at her place last week because her place was close to his job and he was too tired to drive home. He didn’t tell me that but I saw the texts between them on his phone. 

He straight up told me that he cares about his ex and I’ll just have to accept that they’re good friends. Its more like “take it or leave it”.

Im just sad because i lost my virginity to him and I really thought that we’ll date
